author: bartosik-hep
body:
#### PR description:

New baseline Tracker geometry is introduced: **T40** (last presented on [Nov 4, 2026](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1741226/contributions/7339021/))
* synchronised with the latest CAD designs
* consistent orientation and numbering of the modules
* added big pixels in IT and OT (last presented by @emiglior on [Jan 16, 2026](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1628558/contributions/6877389/))
* removed obsolete files that are not used by any current geometries

Expected changes:
* updated module orientations have made the Lorentz-angle shift of OT clusters symmetric in `localX`, while it was negative before, in `T35` geometry;
* slightly increased material budget in TBPX (less than 3%)

**To be noted:**
* big pixels in PS-p sensors required a change in the L1 stub-building algorithm, which assumed uniform pitch until now; I've implemented a simple fix in `L1Trigger/TrackTrigger/src/TTStubAlgorithm_official.cc` to recover the `L1Stub` efficiency , but it might need a better implementation in the future (to be followed up  with @tomalin )
* increased `dphi` assert from `0.001` to `0.005` in `L1Trigger/TrackFindingTracklet/src/MatchProcessor.cc` to avoid occasional crashes with big pixels in OT  (to be reviewed by @tomalin)
* Reco material maps produced might need review by Tracking POG. The current version has been produced by @ataliercio following the recipe by @bdanzi

We're open to excluding `D130` scenario and/or merging `D129` into `D128` if deemed beneficial by Simulation group.

#### PR validation:

New standard Phase2 workflows have been added for each of the new geometries.

Workflows `38810` and `39210` (`FourMuExtendedPt_1_200_pythia8_Run4`) have been run to test geometries `T40` and `T41` respectively.
In addition, workflows `38823` (`MinBias_13TeV_pythia8_TuneCUETP8M1_Run4`) and `38834` (`TTbar_14TeV_TuneCP5_Run4`) have been run for further tests of `T40`, and compared to corresponding workflows with `T35`, showing no unexpected differences.

Attached plots showing the L1Stub performance:
[2026_11_16_stubs.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34977264/2026_11_16_stubs.pdf)
title: New Tracker geometries: T40, T41
